授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This course is an intensive lecture on patent acquisition and the establishment of bio-ventures. The instructor is Dr. Masaya Miyazaki, President of HaKaL Inc., a venture company founded in collaboration with AIST and Kyushu University.
The course is delivered as a practitioner-led intensive lecture by HaKaL Inc. and will be conducted online via Zoom or similar platforms (no in-person attendance required). Participants are required to have a stable internet connection, a computer, and access to a microphone and camera.
This course provides students interested in startup formation and patent application practices in the fields of biotechnology and chemistry with an opportunity to acquire practical knowledge. As the course includes interactive lectures and discussions, active participation is required.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
本講義の目的は、バイオ・化学分野における研究成果を社会実装する過程で重要となる、
① 特許戦略の基礎と実務、
② バイオベンチャーの立ち上げに必要なビジネススキルや資金調達の知識
を、実務経験豊富な講師から体系的かつ具体的に学ぶことです。
受講者は、アイディアをどのように「技術」として権利化し、事業として成立させていくのかというプロセスを実例とともに学ぶことで、アカデミアと産業界をつなぐ視点を養います。また、講義後には、将来的に研究成果を事業化する可能性を見据えた発想力や戦略構想力の育成をめざします。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
The objective of this course is to provide a systematic and practical understanding—delivered by an instructor with extensive hands-on experience—of the following key areas essential for translating research outcomes in the fields of bioscience and chemistry into real-world applications:
The fundamentals and practice of patent strategy
Business skills and knowledge of fundraising necessary for launching a biotech venture
Through real-world examples, students will learn the process of how ideas can be transformed into "technologies" with legal rights and developed into viable businesses. This will help cultivate the ability to bridge academia and industry. Furthermore, the course aims to foster creative thinking and strategic planning skills with an eye toward the future commercialization of research outcomes.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考:
HaKaL Inc. is a startup company originating from Kyushu University, established in November 2020. Its headquarters and R&D facilities are located in the Kurume Research Park in Kurume City, Fukuoka Prefecture.
**Business Overview**
HaKaL develops and provides technologies that enable rapid chemical measurements in on-site settings across agriculture, environmental, and biotechnology fields. Its main business activities include:
* **Development and sales of rapid measurement reagent kits:**
The company develops reagent kits for a wide range of applications, including detection of plant pathogens and viruses, analysis of nutrient solutions in hydroponics, measurement of soil and water components, environmental pollutants, and biomolecules.
* **Provision of on-site measurement technologies:**
By combining compact, low-cost measurement devices with high-sensitivity reagents, HaKaL provides on-site measurement kits that enable rapid chemical analysis directly in the field.
* **Contract research and consulting:**
The company offers contract research services related to chemical measurement, as well as technology development and consulting in relevant fields.
